fields.description: Change: a pending change of an existing task or visit. New task: a task that does not exist yet and is only created when its planner presses Publish (no Task, no assignment and no calendar event until then).
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: The task this Project Planner draft changes. Blank on a Maintenance Planner draft (it names its visit instead) and on a drafted new task.
fields.label: Task

fields.description: The maintenance visit this Maintenance Planner draft changes. Blank on a Project Planner draft.
fields.label: Visit

fields.description: The project a drafted new task will be created on. Blank on a change of an existing task or visit.
fields.label: Project

fields.description: The Task this drafted new task became when it was published.
fields.label: Created task

fields.description: The task's or visit's last-modified time when this change was drafted. One changed since then is not published over.
fields.label: Modified when drafted

fields.description: The drafted change as JSON: the Project Planner's save arguments for a task (dates, hours, crew size, crew, qualifications), a visit's drafted day, technician, crew, length, Full day and pencil flag, or, for a drafted new task, the Task it will become when published (its fields, crew, qualifications, equipment and what it waits on). Written by the planners only.
fields.label: Drafted change

fields.description: The reason given when this change was published over a conflict.
fields.label: Reason
